description_en: Obtain a new upload credential for a media asset after its upload credential expires
description_zh: 本接口用于媒资文件上传超时后重新获取媒资上传凭证，也可用于媒资文件的覆盖上传（即获取到源文件上传地址后重新上传且音/视频ID保持不变）
name: RefreshUploadMedia

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset
parameters.name: media_id

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the media asset

UploadAddress.description_en:
The upload URL.

The returned upload URL is a Base64-encoded URL. You must decode the Base64-encoded upload URL before you use an SDK or call an API operation to upload media files. You need to parse UploadAddress only if you use Object Storage Service (OSS) SDK or call an OSS API operation to upload media files
UploadAddress.description_zh:
上传地址。
接口返回的上传地址是Base64加密后的值。调用SDK或API完成媒资上传时需要对其进行Base64解码后再使用。仅OSS原生SDK或OSS API方式上传需要自行解析UploadAddress

UploadAuth.description_en:
The upload credential.

The returned upload credential is a Base64-encoded value. You must decode the Base64-encoded upload credential before you use an SDK or call an API operation to upload media files. You need to parse UploadAuth only if you use OSS SDK or call an OSS API operation to upload media files
UploadAuth.description_zh:
上传凭证。
接口返回的上传凭证是Base64加密后的值。调用SDK或API完成媒资上传时需要对其进行Base64解码后再使用。仅OSS原生SDK或OSS API方式上传需要自行解析UploadAuth
